title: Using zal
text:
Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/401f89e5e0fc81ebabb5f108d18fde5e as of 2026-10-22T22:50:43.242Z: {"Bronhoofdstuk":6,"Hoofdstukken":["https://app.notion.com/p/401f89e5e0fc8123a771c4658330b3eb"],"Inhoudsstatus":"Aanwezig","Onderwerp":"Using zal","Ontbreekt":"","Type":"Grammatica","url":"https://app.notion.com/p/401f89e5e0fc81ebabb5f108d18fde5e"} null Zal / zullen Use zal/zullen + infinitive for a future action or promise. The message chapter uses it to say what you will do next. ## Examples from the archive - Dat zal ik doen! — I’ll do that! - Ik zal ook vragen welke oefeningen ik moet maken. — I’ll also ask which exercises I need to do. - Ik zal wat later zijn. — I’ll be a little late. The archive supplies this opening before want/omdat. ## Pattern Subject + zal/zullen + other information + infinitive. - ik zal; hij/zij zal - jij/je zal or zult; u zal or zult - wij/we, jullie, zij/ze zullen In Dat zal ik doen, dat comes first, so the conjugated verb zal comes before the subject ik. Doen is the infinitive at the end. ## Try it 1. Ik … wat later … . (zal + zijn) 2. Start with Dat: Ik zal dat doen. 3. Change Ik zal dat doen to Wij …. Answers 1. Ik zal wat later zijn. 2. Dat zal ik doen. 3. Wij zullen dat doen. ## Sources and chapter links Source and related chapters English study explanation written from the examples and learning goals in archived chapter 6. This is a new learning aid; the archive does not contain the missing original grammar handout.
